course.title: Database Systems
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose you are given the following requirements for a simple database for the Bangladesh (10) Premier League (BPL).

The BPL has many teams; each team has a name, a city, a coach, a captain, and a set of players; each player belongs to only one team; each player has a name, ID, a position (such as bowler, batsman, all-rounder), a skill level, and a set of injury records; a team captain is also a player; a game is played between two teams (host and guest team) that has a date and status (win, loss, drawn, postponed).
Construct a clear and concise ER diagram for the BPL database. Show the relationships with cardinalities.
